_comment: Pattern 5 mutation run over @calypso/crypto-test-vectors — the cross-platform known-answer crypto vectors. SCOPE: only the vector files whose values this package's OWN parity tests re-derive through the real crypto (HKDF / HMAC-SHA256 / SubtleCrypto / analyseStyle), so a mutated literal is genuinely killable here: conversation-vectors.ts, search-key-vectors.ts, search-hmac-vectors.ts, search-hmac-parity-vectors.ts, stylometric-vectors.ts, citation-anchor-vectors.ts. The autogenerated frozen envelope/seed/biometric/verification-blob fixtures are DELIBERATELY excluded: they are static conformance data with no in-package re-derivation (their parity tests live in the server/mobile auth suites), so mutating them here yields only uncoverable survivors — see docs/quality/mutation-triage/packages-vectors-fetch-ui.md. Pure package, hermetic tests. Dedicated vitest.mutation.config.ts pinned to pool:'forks'. Non-blocking (thresholds.break=null). See docs/quality/mutation-testing.md.
